definitions.formal_definition: An ordered pair (x, y) that uniquely specifies the exact spatial location of a point in a 2D Cartesian plane relative to origin O(0,0).

definitions.formal_definition: A single-variable polynomial p(x) = ax + b of degree 1 where a and b are real numbers and a != 0.
The complete set of numbers comprising all rational numbers (Q) and irrational numbers (Q'), representing every continuous point on the number line.
A linear binomial (x - a) is a polynomial factor of p(x) if and only if evaluating the polynomial at x = a yields p(a) = 0.
The locus of all points in a plane that are at a fixed non-zero distance (radius r) from a fixed central point O.

definitions.formal_definition: The ratio of the number of outcomes favorable to an event E to the total number of equally likely outcomes in sample space S: P(E) = n(E) / n(S).

steps: Start at origin O(0,0).

procedures.procedure_name: Converting Recurring Decimals to p/q Form
steps: Set x equal to the repeating decimal (e.g., x = 0.4545...).
Identify periodicity k (number of repeating digits).
Multiply equation by 10^k to shift one repeating block across decimal point.
Subtract original equation from multiplied equation to cancel infinite decimal tail.
Solve for x and simplify fraction to lowest terms p/q.

procedures.procedure_name: Factorising Quadratic Polynomials by Splitting Middle Term
steps: Identify coefficients a, b, c in ax^2 + bx + c.
Calculate product a * c and target sum b.
Find two numbers p and q such that p * q = a * c and p + q = b.
Rewrite middle term bx as px + qx.
Factor by grouping pairs to obtain binomial factors (mx + n)(px + q).

procedures.procedure_name: Locating Center of Circle using Chords
steps: Draw two non-parallel chords AB and CD on the circular boundary.
Construct the perpendicular bisector of chord AB using compass and straightedge.
Construct the perpendicular bisector of chord CD.
Mark the intersection point of the two perpendicular bisectors as center O.

steps: Verify side lengths a, b, c.
Compute semi-perimeter s = (a + b + c) / 2.
Compute individual differences (s - a), (s - b), and (s - c).
Multiply s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c).
Extract prime factor pairs to take exact square root.
